senses.gloss:
माढि माढि, इस्, f. = दल-स्नसा, the fibre
or vein of a leaf (= पत्त्र-शिरा); the germ of
leaves, the young leaf before it opens; honouring,
respecting, reverencing, (in this sense fr. rt. मह्);
dejection, sadness, affliction; poverty, indigence,
manifestation of poverty, declaration of distress;
anger, passion; a back or double tooth; the hem
or border of a garment; N. of a district.
माढी, f. = दन्त-शिरा, a back or double tooth.
